gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoine: Open curves that stop short of the stem give this body text a modern, unhurried feel. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined handles the steady reading, while Expose packs its punch into tight, compressed display lines.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Expose is all compression, its capitals nearly level with the lowercase and hardly a pause between letters. Noto Sans Armenian stands tall and full in its lowercase, with round letters that open generously.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Noto Sans Bamum reads modern and clean, its curved strokes stopping before they turn inward. And Expose does the opposite job, squeezing striking display letters close while the body keeps its counters big.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-batak: Stubby-pencil lowercase, big and friendly on the line. Noto Sans Batak keeps its e open and unsqueezed, while Expose runs refined and compressed with barely a breath between letters.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Noto Sans Bengali has capitals barely taller than its lowercase and distinctly open letter mouths, which gives text a contemporary, businesslike look. Long stretches read smoothly beneath Expose's compressed, striking headings.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Coiled-rope lowercase meets a compressed, striking display face. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki fills out its lowercase with readable open apertures, while Expose stays refined and tightly packed beside it, line after line.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid has generous space between curve ends and stems, plus a high-set x-height, so text feels modern and businesslike. Pages of it would move along easily under Expose's compressed headings.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian has a large x-height, short ascenders and curves that stop short instead of closing in. Expose, by contrast, is striking and compressed, its capitals nearly matching the lowercase.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Clean and contemporary, Noto Sans Cuneiform lets its e open up and fills the lowercase out like inflated glass beads. Beside Expose's compressed, refined headings, it feels softer and looser.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads clean and modern, with open apertures throughout and ascenders that barely clear the x-height. And long text would flow without friction under Expose's striking, refined, compressed headings.
